accounts.user_A: existing user id 1 (JWT minted at runtime, not stored)

user_B.password: [generated at runtime, never written to evidence]

PR-01.objective: Auth response hygiene: /api/auth/me must return profile without credential fields
PR-01.expected: 200 with id/name/email/created_at only; no password/hash/token fields

PR-02.objective: Session scoping: audit user B authenticates and sees only own identity
PR-02.actual: HTTP 200; B sees only own profile: True; body email=audit.b.1790610596@example.com

PR-03.objective: Cross-user data leakage: B's wardrobe list must never contain user-1 items
PR-03.expected: 200 with B's empty (or B-only) wardrobe; zero user-1 item codes
PR-03.actual: HTTP 200; B wardrobe rows=0; user-1 codes leaked to B: none

PR-04.objective: IDOR read: B requests user-1 wardrobe item by direct id
PR-04.actual: HTTP 404; IDOR read of user-1 item 25 succeeded: False

PR-05.objective: IDOR update: B attempts PUT-mutation of user-1 wardrobe item
PR-05.expected: Write rejected AND item unchanged when re-read by owner
PR-05.actual: B-write HTTP 404; item colour now mutated: False

PR-06.objective: IDOR delete: B attempts DELETE of user-1 wardrobe item
PR-06.expected: Delete rejected; item still present afterwards
PR-06.actual: B-delete HTTP 404; user-1 item still exists afterwards: True

PR-07.objective: IDOR read: B fetches user-1 outfit analysis by request_id
PR-07.actual: HTTP 404; B read user-1 analysis REQ-2026-11225C: False

PR-08.objective: Recent-analysis exposure: B's /api/analyze/recent/latest must not return user-1 analysis
PR-08.expected: null (B has no history) — never user-1's record
PR-08.actual: HTTP 200; B latest-analysis is user-1's analysis: False; body is null: True

PR-09.objective: Unauthenticated + malformed token handling on protected endpoint
PR-09.expected: 401 for all variants; generic error, no stack traces/secrets/SQL
PR-09.actual: HTTP statuses: no-auth->401, garbage-bearer->401, empty-bearer->401; stack/secret in error bodies: False

PR-10.objective: Token tampering: signature-flipped copy of a valid JWT
PR-10.actual: HTTP 401 on signature-tampered JWT; data served: False

PR-11.objective: Expired session: JWT minted with negative expiry
PR-11.actual: HTTP 401 on expired JWT; data served: False

PR-12.objective: Token forgery: unsigned alg:none JWT claiming sub=1
PR-12.actual: HTTP 401 on alg:none forged JWT; data served: False

PR-13.objective: Search-history isolation (Agent 2): B must not see, read, or delete user-1 history
PR-13.expected: B list excludes A records; A-history GET/DELETE as B rejected
PR-13.actual: B list contaminated with A history: False; B GET A-history HTTP 404; B DELETE A-history HTTP 404

PR-14.actual: B->user1 usage HTTP 403 (leak=False); B->own usage HTTP 200

PR-15.objective: Account enumeration: duplicate-register message + unknown-email vs wrong-password login
PR-15.expected: Ideal: identical login errors, non-revealing duplicate message
PR-15.actual: dup-register HTTP 400 (existence-revealing msg: True); unknown-email HTTP 401; login errors indistinguishable: True

PR-16.objective: Credential storage: audit user B password persisted as bcrypt hash, never plaintext
PR-16.expected: Stored value starts with bcrypt prefix; plaintext not present in column
PR-16.actual: stored hash prefix=$2b$; bcrypt=True; length=60; plaintext present: False

PR-17.objective: Sensitive image storage: wardrobe image via /uploads without auth + path traversal
PR-17.expected: Traversal blocked; unauthenticated image accessibility documented
PR-17.actual: unauth image fetch HTTP 200 (image bytes served: True); path-traversal HTTP 404, source served: False

PR-18.objective: Error-message leakage: validation failure and missing-file responses
PR-18.expected: 422/404 with generic detail; no traceback, SQL, or config internals
PR-18.actual: invalid-item HTTP 422; missing-image HTTP 404; internals in error text: False
